purpose: Authoritative operational record of source inclusion and exclusion decisions. This file records candidate-ingestion decisions separately from public-release rights clearance.
authority: This decision register supersedes contradictory historical source-discovery notes and blanket exclusions where a narrower decision is recorded. Source-specific provenance and rights conditions remain binding.
